title: Airframe micro-scratch normal breakup
change: Add a restrained fine-scratch normal layer to exposed Yak airframe metal.
implementation_notes: Blend an existing imported scratch normal at low strength over the HF metal response; keep base color and roughness unchanged and mask to broad exposed panels.
capture_safe_reason: Unlit HF-only treatment preserves the Loop52 bright material baseline and adds no hero geometry or dark FOV regions.
acceptance_test: Loop52 capture remains 11/11 usable; YakBeauty shows fine edge breakup without a new black patch.

title: Airframe panel roughness variance
change: Introduce subtle roughness variation between adjacent airframe panels.
implementation_notes: Use an existing panel mask or imported roughness tile with narrow contrast; bias toward satin-versus-matte separation without darkening albedo.
capture_safe_reason: Only roughness is varied, retaining current luminance and avoiding dark-metal sole-FOV behavior.
acceptance_test: YakBeauty and Cockpit retain usable framing and show readable panel breaks without washout.

title: Airframe seam AO restraint
change: Add a thin ambient-occlusion accent to selected airframe panel seams.
implementation_notes: Multiply a low-opacity seam AO mask into existing shading and clamp the minimum value so seams cannot become black bars.
capture_safe_reason: The accent is narrow, local, and luminance-clamped, with no effect on distant views.
acceptance_test: YakBeauty gains seam definition while black-pixel coverage stays flat or improves.

title: Airframe lower-surface dust gradient
change: Add a soft, low-contrast dust accumulation gradient to lower airframe surfaces.
implementation_notes: Project a warm-gray dirt response through a height-biased mask; exclude canopy, nose highlight, and cockpit instrument FOV.
capture_safe_reason: The dust is a subtle material layer on existing surfaces and remains away from horizon and ocean pixels.
acceptance_test: The lower Yak reads lightly field-used while Cockpit readability and 11/11 usability remain unchanged.

title: Airframe edge polish strip
change: Add a narrow brighter response along selected airframe panel lips.
implementation_notes: Drive a very low-intensity neutral-warm additive highlight from an existing edge mask; limit it to thin strips.
capture_safe_reason: This is a small emissive proxy over existing panel edges with negligible influence outside the Yak close view.
acceptance_test: Panel lips gain one readable highlight pass without clipping sky or increasing black coverage.

title: Prop disc translucent value band
change: Add one restrained brightness band to the spinning propeller disc material.
implementation_notes: Place a narrow low-opacity band in the existing disc UVs and keep emission dim enough to preserve hub contrast.
capture_safe_reason: The change is additive, tiny, and isolated to the prop disc.
acceptance_test: Prop and PropHub show a stable readable disc ring without obscuring the hub.

title: Prop disc radial breakup
change: Introduce subtle radial breakup so the prop disc reads as a rotating surface rather than a flat blur.
implementation_notes: Use a low-contrast radial mask to modulate the existing disc response; keep the center clear and change no blade geometry.
capture_safe_reason: It affects only the existing rotating disc material with a restrained additive signal.
acceptance_test: PropNose retains nose-edge readability and Prop gains radial motion structure without overexposure.

title: Prop hub brushed-metal grain
change: Add a fine brushed-metal normal and roughness cue to the prop hub.
implementation_notes: Apply grain only inside the existing hub mask; use a neutral mid-value base and preserve the current bright rim.
capture_safe_reason: The detail is confined to the existing hub material and maintains a non-dark base value.
acceptance_test: PropHub gains visible concentric brushing without blackening the hub or reducing disc separation.

title: Prop blade leading-edge wear
change: Add a thin warm-gray wear response to propeller blade leading edges.
implementation_notes: Use an existing blade-edge mask with a low-contrast albedo/roughness blend; keep wear discontinuous and narrower than the blade width.
capture_safe_reason: This is a local material-only edge cue with no aircraft silhouette change.
acceptance_test: Leading edges read lightly worn in Prop while PropNose remains clear and no dark stripe appears.

title: Prop disc center-to-rim fade
change: Refine the disc material with a gentle center-to-rim value fade.
implementation_notes: Add very low-strength radial emission that rises toward the outer disc and falls to zero at the hub boundary.
capture_safe_reason: The effect is additive, localized, and kept below highlight clipping.
acceptance_test: The prop disc separates cleanly from the hub and nose at Loop52 exposure.

title: Rifle tan woven grain

acceptance_test: ADS shows tactile stock grain without adding noise to the cockpit background.

title: Rifle tan corner abrasion

title: Rifle worn-metal roughness pass

implementation_notes: Apply an existing roughness tile through the metal-part mask, keeping metal base color mid-value and avoiding a blackened receiver or sight.
